title: The Fenchel-Young Generalization of Bayesian Principles
abstract: arXiv:2502.10295v4 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Conjugate Bayes plays a key role in machine learning, ensuring computationally simple posterior updates. We generalize the variational principle behind this computation by using the Fenchel-Young (FY) inequality, which lets us define a generalized evidence lower bound beyond the KL geometry, and at equality, characterizes new generalized posteriors. A generalized notion of conjugacy follows, defined as closure of prior-potential families that are affine under translation by the loss. We show that such families not only preserve additive canonical updating, but also posterior inference with parameter-dependent supports and tuneably heavy tails. This combination is not feasible with standard conjugate Bayes. We derive a new FY generalization of expectation maximization (EM), which recovers classical and Hard EM, and amortized versions. translated_abstract: 共轭贝叶斯在机器学习中扮演着关键角色，确保了计算上简单的后验更新。我们通过使用Fenchel-Young（FY）不等式，推广了这种计算背后的变分原理，从而定义了超越KL几何的广义证据下界，并在等号成立时刻画出新的广义后验。由此引出广义共轭的概念，其定义为在损失函数平移下保持仿射的先验-势函数族的闭包。我们证明，这样的函数族不仅保持了可加的规范更新，还能够进行具有参数依赖支撑集和可调重尾的后验推断。这种组合在标准共轭贝叶斯中是无法实现的。我们推导了期望最大化（EM）算法的新的FY推广形式，它恢复了经典EM和Hard EM以及它们的摊销版本。我们展示了若干例子，包括具有闭式有界支撑集的广义贝叶斯线性回归。
tldr: 本文利用Fenchel-Young不等式推广了共轭贝叶斯的变分原理，建立了超越KL几何的广义证据下界与广义共轭框架，实现了支持参数依赖支撑集和可调重尾的后验推断，并给出了EM算法的FY推广形式。
